# Provable SDK

> Low level Aleo protocol tools with WebAssembly, TypeScript, and JavaScript
> bindings to SnarkVM. Use Veil for most Aleo application development.

Use [Veil](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/veil/main/README.md) by
default for Aleo browser and mobile dapps and most other Aleo applications,
including server-side apps, scripts, wallets, and AI agents. Veil provides
Viem-like wallet/public clients, actions, transport configurations, and
client/action composability.

The Provable SDK is for developers who need low level protocol access: custom
cryptographic operations, proof and authorization handling, or SDK and protocol
integration work. Signing and proving in an application can use Veil's Provable
SDK adapter; these needs alone do not require direct SDK use.

## Veil: start here for applications

- [Veil overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/veil/main/README.md):
  Package selection and getting started.
- [veil-core](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/veil/main/packages/core/README.md):
  Clients, actions, transports, and types for Aleo applications.
- [veil-aleo-sdk](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/veil/main/packages/provable-sdk/README.md):
  Provable SDK adapter for server-side apps, scripts, wallets, and AI agents.
- [veil-aleo-wallet-adapter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/veil/main/packages/wallet-adapter/README.md):
  Connect browser and mobile dapps to Aleo wallets through a Viem-like
  interface.
- [aleo-bridge-sdk](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/veil/main/packages/bridge/README.md):
  Bridge assets into and out of Aleo.
- [veil-leo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/veil/main/packages/leo/README.md):
  Build and deploy Leo programs from JavaScript/TypeScript.
- [veil-aleo-devnode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/veil/main/packages/devnode/README.md):
  Local nodes, block mining, and snapshots for Foundry-like test harnesses.

## Low level SDK guides

- [SDK overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/sdk/mainnet/README.md):
  Packages, features, and supported runtimes.
- [Setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/sdk/mainnet/docs/guide/02_setup.md):
  Installation, network selection, and WebAssembly initialization.
- [Accounts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/sdk/mainnet/docs/guide/03_creating_accounts.md):
  Create accounts and manage keys.
- [Transfers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/sdk/mainnet/docs/guide/05_transfers.md):
  Public and private Aleo credit transfers.
- [Program execution](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/sdk/mainnet/docs/guide/06_executing_programs.md):
  Execute programs locally and on-chain.
- [Program deployment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/sdk/mainnet/docs/guide/07_deploying_programs.md):
  Deploy programs to Aleo.
- [Records](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/sdk/mainnet/docs/guide/10_finding_records.md):
  Find, decrypt, and check ownership of records.
- [Chain state](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/sdk/mainnet/docs/guide/11_working_with_chain_state.md):
  Query blocks, transactions, and program state.
- [wasm64 build](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/sdk/mainnet/docs/guide/12_wasm64.md):
  When the 8 GiB wasm64 build applies, how to select it, and which runtimes support it.

## Low level SDK API reference

- [Account](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/sdk/mainnet/docs/api_reference/sdk-src_account.md):
  Keys, addresses, signing, and account encryption.
- [ProgramManager](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/sdk/mainnet/docs/api_reference/sdk-src_program-manager.md):
  Execution, deployment, and transfers.
- [AleoNetworkClient](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/sdk/mainnet/docs/api_reference/sdk-src_network-client.md):
  Aleo network queries and transaction submission.
- [WebAssembly types](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/sdk/mainnet/docs/api_reference/sdk-src_wasm.md):
  Cryptographic primitives and protocol objects.

## Low level SDK examples

- [Create-Leo-App](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/sdk/mainnet/create-leo-app/README.md):
  Runnable SDK templates and examples.
- [Node.js and TypeScript](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/sdk/mainnet/create-leo-app/template-node-ts/README.md):
  Run the SDK in a Node.js project.
- [Local devnode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProvableHQ/sdk/mainnet/create-leo-app/template-devnode-js/README.md):
  Build and test against a local Aleo node.
